name: brainsnack
description: Turn AI-agent wait time into short, useful reading — without leaving VS Code.

brainsnack.feedUrl.markdownDescription: URL of a published `feed.json`. Defaults to the project's own feed. Point it at your own if you run the generator yourself, or leave it empty to use only the content bundled with the extension.

brainsnack.autoOpen.description: Open the BrainSnack sidebar automatically when Claude starts working. Never steals keyboard focus.

brainsnack.interests.description: Card types to include in the feed.

brainsnack.tracks.markdownDescription: Technology tracks to include. Applies to Learn and Output cards, the only ones that carry a track — news and blogs are always shown. Narrow this to the areas you actually work in.

brainsnack.maxCards.description: Maximum number of cards kept in the feed.

brainsnack.removeAnsweredAfterSeconds.description: Seconds an answered output-based question stays on screen before clearing itself. Saving it cancels the removal. Set to 0 to keep answered cards. Only applies to output questions.

brainsnack.refreshMinutes.description: How often to re-fetch the feed, in minutes. Set to 0 to disable.

brainsnack.sound.enabled.description: Play a sound when Claude needs input or finishes.

brainsnack.sound.onWaiting.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a sound file played when Claude needs input. Leave empty for the platform default.

brainsnack.sound.onFinished.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a sound file played when Claude finishes. Leave empty for the platform default.

brainsnack.statusBar.enabled.description: Show a spinning status bar item while Claude is working.

brainsnack.hookPort.description: Localhost port the extension listens on for Claude Code hook events. Re-run the install command after changing this.

scripts.build: npm run build:webview && npm run build:ext
scripts.admin:demo: node -e "const f=require('./content/seed-feed.json');require('fs').mkdirSync('data',{recursive:true});require('fs').writeFileSync('data/queue.json',JSON.stringify(f.cards,null,2));console.log('Queued '+f.cards.length+' demo cards. Run: npm run admin')"
scripts.publish:vsce: npm run package && npx --yes @vscode/vsce publish --packagePath brainsnack-$npm_package_version.vsix
scripts.publish:ovsx: npm run package && npx --yes ovsx publish brainsnack-$npm_package_version.vsix
